sources.title: PeopleGroups.org — Saho of Eritrea (PGID PG011532)
sources.locator: Current profile fast facts and resource sections: Saho in Eritrea, Saho (ssy), aggregate Sunni Islam label, GSEC 1 / Unengaged and Unreached, JESUS film listing and Bible-resource surfaces. Live PEID identity must be re-fetched before publication.

sources.title: Glottolog 5.3 — Saho
sources.publisher: Max Planck Institute for Evolutionary Anthropology / Glottolog
sources.locator: Saho spoken L1 language entry: glottocode saho1246, ISO 639-3 ssy; countries Eritrea and Ethiopia.

sources.title: Housing and dwelling among the Saho-speaking communities of Eritrea and Ethiopia: History, anthropology and lexicography
sources.locator: Field-research volume covering approximately twenty Saho-speaking localities, dwelling/material-culture terminology, sociofamilial aspects and dialect variation; published by University of Trieste Press.

sources.title: A Sketch of Saho Grammar
sources.publisher: Journal of Eritrean Studies / authors archived by Saho Archive
sources.locator: Bibliographic and introductory material for Banti and Vergari's 2005 grammar sketch: Saho as an East Cushitic language, description of the central/northern variety and Eritrean orthography.

whoTheyAre.summary: The current PeopleGroups.org record identifies Saho in Eritrea and ties the record to Saho (ssy). Glottolog independently identifies Saho in Eritrea and Ethiopia, while recent interdisciplinary field research documents material-culture, household and dialect variation across multiple Saho-speaking localities.

religionAndCommunity.summary: PeopleGroups.org provides an aggregate Sunni Islam label for this people-group-in-country record. It is preserved as source context and is not generalized into a statement about every Saho person's belief or practice.

profile.whyUnreachedIntro: This candidate explains the current mission classification only from PeopleGroups.org source-native fields. Language, culture, household patterns and religion are not treated as causes of unreached status.

whyUnreached.heading: Current source mission status
whyUnreached.summary: PeopleGroups.org currently reports PG011532 below the 2% evangelical threshold with GSEC 1 and no recent church-planting activity, and its SPI presentation is Unengaged and Unreached.

whyUnreached.heading: A listed film is not the same as broad resource access
whyUnreached.summary: The provider currently lists one Saho JESUS film and no Faith Comes by Hearing Bible entry on its language resource surface; this draft does not convert either observation into a claim about total Christian-resource access.

claims.text: The current PeopleGroups.org profile PG011532 identifies the people-group record as Saho in Eritrea and lists Saho (ssy) as its primary language.
claims.interpretationNote: The public profile establishes PGID/name/country/language alignment; the guarded maintainer review must re-fetch the live record and verify PEID before publication.

claims.text: Glottolog identifies Saho with glottocode saho1246 and ISO 639-3 code ssy in Eritrea and Ethiopia, while a published grammar sketch describes it as an East Cushitic language and documents a standardized Eritrean orthography.

A 2022 interdisciplinary field-research volume documents construction techniques, dwelling terminology, household activities and sociofamilial aspects among Saho-speaking communities in Eritrea and Ethiopia.
claims.interpretationNote: The research covers multiple localities and explicitly studies variation; it should not be turned into one uniform household description for all Saho people.

claims.text: Linguistic and anthropological work documents internal dialect and lexical variation across Saho-speaking communities, so the source's single Saho language code is useful for identification but does not erase local linguistic variation.
claims.interpretationNote: This is a language-variation statement, not a claim that every locality uses a distinct dialect.

claims.text: The current PeopleGroups.org Saho of Eritrea profile reports Sunni Islam as its aggregate primary-religion label.
claims.interpretationNote: This is a provider classification for PG011532, not a statement about every Saho person's belief or practice.

claims.text: PeopleGroups.org currently reports GSEC 1, less than 2% evangelical presence and no recent church-planting activity for PG011532, and its profile presents the record as Unengaged and Unreached.
claims.interpretationNote: These are source-native mission-research fields for one people-group-in-country record, not a judgment about individuals.

claims.text: The current PeopleGroups.org profile lists one JESUS film on its Saho resource surface and currently shows no Faith Comes by Hearing Bible-resource entry for Saho, while also linking to a Bible.com language surface.
claims.interpretationNote: Provider surfaces can differ by partner and do not establish total Scripture availability, distribution, comprehension or use.
